title: rosa canina subvar. dolosa
intro: Rosa canina subvar. dolosa, commonly known as a type of wild rose, is a shrub species within the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits associated with Rosa canina subvar. dolosa include its potential to support eye health, reduce inflammation, and aid in digestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as flavonoids and carotenoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
